answer: Reaching eligibility takes 55 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The beacon register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 55 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 110 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
